items.headline: OpenAI completes for-profit restructuring under nonprofit control
items.summary: OpenAI finalized its transition to a public benefit corporation with the nonprofit retaining oversight and a substantial equity stake. The restructuring clears the path for continued fundraising while addressing governance concerns raised by regulators and critics.

items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.5 with coding gains
items.summary: Anthropic announced its latest flagship model touting improved agentic coding and long-context reasoning performance. The release intensifies competition with OpenAI and Google in the enterprise developer market.

items.headline: Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 3 model family
items.summary: Google DeepMind launched its next-generation Gemini 3 models with enhanced multimodal and reasoning capabilities. The models are being integrated across Google products and the Vertex AI platform for enterprise customers.

items.headline: Nvidia becomes first company to reach $5 trillion valuation
items.summary: Nvidia's market capitalization crossed the $5 trillion mark driven by sustained AI chip demand. The milestone underscores the continued centrality of hardware to the AI infrastructure boom.

items.headline: EU begins enforcing AI Act general-purpose model rules
items.summary: The European Union started applying key provisions of the AI Act targeting general-purpose AI models and systemic risk obligations. Major providers must now comply with transparency, documentation, and safety requirements or face significant fines.

items.headline: Microsoft expands Copilot with autonomous agent features
items.summary: Microsoft announced new agentic capabilities across its Copilot suite enabling multi-step task automation for enterprise workflows. The update deepens AI integration into Microsoft 365 and Dynamics products.

items.headline: OpenAI signs multi-billion dollar compute deal with chipmakers
items.summary: OpenAI announced major infrastructure partnerships to secure vast compute capacity for training and serving future models. The deals reflect escalating capital requirements and supply constraints across the AI industry.

items.headline: Meta releases new Llama model update for enterprises
items.summary: Meta published an updated open-weight Llama model targeting improved efficiency and enterprise deployment. The move reinforces Meta's open-model strategy against proprietary competitors.

items.headline: Anthropic raises major funding round at higher valuation
items.summary: Anthropic secured a large new financing round significantly boosting its valuation amid intense investor interest in frontier AI labs. The capital will fund expanded compute and research efforts.

items.headline: Mistral launches new frontier model and API updates
items.summary: Mistral announced a new model release alongside pricing and API changes aimed at developers and enterprises. The European lab continues to position itself as a competitive open alternative to US rivals.
